name: joplin-mcp
description: Interact with your Joplin notebook from Claude — manage notes, folders, tags, and search.
long_description:
A local MCP server that connects Claude to your Joplin notebook via the Joplin Data API. Requires Joplin (desktop app) to be running with Web Clipper enabled.

Features:
- **Notes**: list, search, create, update, delete
- **Folders**: browse hierarchy, create, delete
- **Tags**: list, apply, remove, delete
- **Search**: full-text search across all notes

The server auto-discovers the Joplin port (41184–41194) and connects lazily on the first tool call, so it starts cleanly even if Joplin is not yet open.
